Building on this taxonomy, we identify open challenges and future directions in training process observability, cross-stage coordination, generalizable RLOps, multi-run management, and RLOps for recursive self-improvement. These directions extend operational management from individual training runs to diverse training settings, shared infrastructure, and successive improvement cycles. We maintain a GitHub repository indexing relevant papers and open resources at https://github.com/zhanglingzhe0820/Awesome-RLOps.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型RLOps综述
AI.tldr: 这篇综述系统地介绍了大型语言模型（LLM）的强化学习操作（RLOps），将其方法分为五个阶段，并指出了开放挑战和未来方向，旨在提高LLM强化学习训练的效率和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习（RL）对于提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理、指令遵循和任务解决能力日益重要。然而，扩展RL训练会暴露出分布式执行、反馈计算和学习动态方面的故障，这可能浪费计算资源、减慢训练速度并损害模型改进。这些挑战促使了LLM RLOps技术的发展，这些技术管理着LLM强化学习训练生命周期中操作的效率和可靠性。尽管人们对此兴趣日益增长，但这些技术分散在各个研究领域，对其操作角色和相互作用的综合分析有限。本论文旨在弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 本文对LLM RLOps方法进行了系统综述。我们将现有方法组织成五个阶段：训练设置、经验收集、奖励计算、策略优化和模型评估。在每个阶段中，我们审视了操作问题、管理技术和评估证据。在此分类法的基础上，我们确定了训练过程可观察性、跨阶段协调、可推广的RLOps、多运行管理以及递归自我改进RLOps方面的开放挑战和未来方向。
AI.result: 本综述构建了一个分类法，并确定了训练过程可观察性、跨阶段协调、可推广的RLOps、多运行管理以及递归自我改进RLOps方面的开放挑战和未来方向。这些方向将操作管理从单个训练运行扩展到多样化的训练设置、共享基础设施和连续改进周期。此外，本研究维护了一个GitHub仓库（https://github.com/zhanglingzhe0820/Awesome-RLOps），收录相关论文和开放资源。
AI.conclusion: 本研究的结论是，通过对LLM RLOps方法的系统综述，我们不仅组织了现有技术，还识别了关键的开放挑战和未来研究方向。这些方向旨在将操作管理从单个训练运行扩展到更广泛的训练设置、共享基础设施和连续的改进周期，从而推动LLM强化学习训练的效率和可靠性。本综述为该领域未来的研究和实践提供了坚实的基础。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）对于提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理、指令遵循和任务解决能力日益重要。然而，扩展RL训练会暴露出分布式执行、反馈计算和学习动态方面的故障，这可能浪费计算资源、减慢训练速度并损害模型改进。这些挑战促使了LLM强化学习操作（RLOps）技术的发展，这些技术管理着LLM强化学习训练生命周期中操作的效率和可靠性。尽管人们对此兴趣日益增长，但这些技术分散在各个研究领域，对其操作角色和相互作用的综合分析有限。为了弥合这一差距，我们对LLM RLOps方法进行了系统综述。我们将现有方法组织成五个阶段：训练设置、经验收集、奖励计算、策略优化和模型评估。在每个阶段中，我们审视了操作问题、管理技术和评估证据。在此分类法的基础上，我们确定了训练过程可观察性、跨阶段协调、可推广的RLOps、多运行管理以及递归自我改进RLOps方面的开放挑战和未来方向。这些方向将操作管理从单个训练运行扩展到多样化的训练设置、共享基础设施和连续改进周期。我们维护一个GitHub仓库，收录相关论文和开放资源，网址为https://github.com/zhanglingzhe0820/Awesome-RLOps。
AI.summary: 本论文系统综述了大型语言模型（LLM）的强化学习操作（RLOps），旨在解决RL训练扩展时面临的效率和可靠性挑战。作者将现有RLOps方法划分为训练设置、经验收集、奖励计算、策略优化和模型评估五个阶段，并详细分析了各阶段的操作问题和管理技术。在此基础上，论文识别了训练过程可观察性、跨阶段协调、可推广RLOps、多运行管理以及递归自我改进RLOps等方面的开放挑战和未来研究方向，为推动LLM强化学习的有效实施提供了全面的视角和指导。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 大型语言模型, RLOps, 综述, 运营管理
AI.comments: 这篇综述文章非常有价值，因为它系统地整理了LLM RLOps这一新兴且关键领域中分散的技术。通过提供一个清晰的分类框架并明确指出未来的研究方向，它为研究人员和实践者提供了一个宝贵的起点，有助于整合知识、优化资源利用，并加速LLM强化学习训练的效率和可靠性。其对操作管理和系统级挑战的关注，也凸显了该领域从理论到实践落地的必要性。

title: Implementing Binary Transformers with Approximate Memories with Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) Protection
summary: Quantization is an effective technique to reduce memory storage, computation complexity and power for Transformers, and the binarization of the weights is important for meeting these requirements. Approximate memory can further reduce the power for memory, but it also introduces errors. Current research for binary Transformers focuses on task performance, but the model dependable operation against errors on the memory has not been well studied. In this paper, we first evaluate the dependability of binary Transformers with the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) as a case study. A large accuracy loss occurs only at high Bit Error Rates (e.g. BER = 5% or 10%). Then we propose a novel Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) scheme to protect the binary weights at very low overhead. This scheme exploits the invariance of Transformers to permutations in the rows and columns to group the critical weights and perform selective protection on those weights. Simulation results show that PIES can recover most of the performance loss caused by bit errors at BERs as high as 10%, at an overhead significantly lower than traditional error correction schemes. These results confirm the feasibility of running binary Transformers using approximate memory with aggressive voltage scaling on resource-limited low power edge devices. The code for PIES is released on github (https://github.com/YangZhutian/binary-transformer-prefix-repair).

AI.title_translation: 利用置换不变性使能选择性（PIES）保护实现带近似内存的二进制Transformer
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为PIES的新型选择性保护方案，利用Transformer的置换不变性，以极低的开销解决了二进制Transformer在近似内存中运行时的错误容忍问题。
AI.motivation: 虽然二进制化和近似内存可以有效降低Transformer的存储和功耗，但近似内存引入的错误对模型可靠性的影响尚未得到充分研究，且传统的错误校正方案开销过大。
AI.method: 以BERT为案例研究评估二进制Transformer在近似内存中的可靠性，并提出了Permutation Invariance Enabled Selective (PIES) 方案，利用Transformer对行和列置换的不变性来对关键权重进行分组和选择性保护。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，PIES能够在高达10%的比特错误率（BER）下恢复大部分因比特错误导致的性能损失，且开销显著低于传统的纠错方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入置换不变性使能的选择性（PIES）保护方案，成功解决二进制Transformer在近似内存中运行时的错误敏感问题，验证了其在资源受限的边缘设备上应用的可行性。
AI.translation: 量化是减少Transformer内存存储、计算复杂度和功耗的有效技术，而权重的二值化对于满足这些要求至关重要。近似内存可以进一步降低内存功耗，但也会引入错误。当前对二值Transformer的研究主要集中在任务性能上，但模型对内存错误的可靠运行尚未得到充分研究。在本文中，我们首先以来自Transformer的双向编码器表示（BERT）为案例研究，评估了二值Transformer的可靠性。大误差仅在高误码率（例如，BER = 5% 或 10%）时发生。然后，我们提出了一种新颖的置换不变性使能选择性（PIES）方案，以极低的开销保护二值权重。该方案利用Transformer对行和列置换的不变性来对关键权重进行分组，并对这些权重执行选择性保护。仿真结果表明，PIES可以恢复在高达10%的BER下由比特错误引起的大部分性能损失，其开销明显低于传统的纠错方案。这些结果证实了在资源受限的低功耗边缘设备上，使用具有激进电压缩放的近似内存运行二值Transformer的可行性。PIES的代码已发布在github上（https://github.com/YangZhutian/binary-transformer-prefix-repair）。
AI.summary: 该论文评估了二进制Transformer在近似内存下的可靠性，并提出了一种名为PIES的新型选择性保护方案，利用Transformer的置换不变性以极低开销保护关键权重，从而在高达10%的误码率下恢复模型性能，证实了二进制Transformer在低功耗边缘设备上应用的可行性。
AI.keywords: 二进制Transformer, 近似内存, 比特错误率, 选择性保护, 置换不变性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将近似内存的硬件容错与变压器模型的量化压缩结合，提出了基于置换不变性的选择性保护方案（PIES），在极低开销下实现了高错误率下的模型性能恢复，对边缘设备上的低功耗部署具有重要意义。

title: Prioritize, Don't Decide: What We Learned Auditing a Deployed Human-in-the-Loop CV Sorter
comments: 11 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Under review at the EACL 2027 Industry Track
summary: A single academic vacancy can draw hundreds of applications, and the first screening round consumes most of a committee's time. We describe a CV Priority Sorter deployed at a national platform for academic vacancies and integrated with its vacancy database. It proposes a reading order for a pile of CVs and leaves every decision to the committee, pairing a frozen multilingual transformer encoder with a per-session linear model that retrains after each label and is discarded when the session ends. It works: on a pool of 300 synthetic CVs, a committee reading in the tool's order reaches 95% of the relevant candidates after half the pile, where an arbitrary order needs almost all of it. This paper is about what we found when we audited that claim, rather than about the system itself. Three findings changed the product. The pool turned out to be sortable by document length alone, which makes precision-style metrics on it uninformative; regenerating it under a shared length budget removes that shortcut and leaves the reading-depth result standing. The four-level agreement score such systems report, ours included, is a binary probability cut at fixed thresholds, so it follows the classifier's confidence rather than its ranking and falls as labels accumulate. And uncertainty sampling, the obvious way to implement a "suggest the next CV" button, leaves model quality intact but raises the committee's total reading load above the no-label baseline, because the CVs it asks about are the ones that would otherwise be skipped. A fourth result shows where to look next: a hosted LLM embedding model lifts zero-label ordinal discrimination from 0.66 to 0.80 under length control, then stops mattering once the session model has two dozen labels; a local cross-encoder matches that cold-start gain without sending data out. We report the fixes each finding forced.
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Under review at the EACL 2027 Industry Track

AI.title_translation: 优先排序，而非决策：审计已部署的人工智能辅助简历筛选系统所学到的经验
AI.tldr: 审计了一个已部署的简历优先级排序系统，发现其性能评估存在缺陷（如文档长度影响），并提出了改进措施和未来方向，强调了优先级而非决策的重要性。
AI.motivation: 解决学术职位申请中简历初筛耗时的问题，并对一个已部署的简历优先级排序系统进行审计，以验证其声称的有效性并发现潜在问题。
AI.method: 审计了一个已部署的简历优先级排序系统。该系统结合了冻结的多语言Transformer编码器和每会话线性模型，用于为简历堆提供阅读顺序。审计过程包括重新生成合成简历池以消除长度偏差、分析协议一致性评分机制、评估不确定性采样策略，并探索使用LLM嵌入模型和本地交叉编码器作为改进方向。
AI.result:
1. 最初的300份合成简历池可通过文档长度排序，导致精度指标失效；在共享长度预算下重新生成后，阅读深度结果仍然成立。
2. 系统报告的四级协议分数实际上是固定阈值下的二元概率截断，随标签积累而下降。
3. 不确定性采样会增加委员会的总阅读负担。
4. 托管的LLM嵌入模型将零标签序数判别能力从0.66提升至0.80（在长度控制下），但在会话模型拥有二三十个标签后便不再重要；本地交叉编码器在不发送数据的情况下实现了相同的冷启动增益。论文报告了每个发现所强制实施的修复措施。
AI.conclusion: 对已部署的简历优先级排序系统进行严格审计揭示了其评估方法和交互设计中的关键缺陷，从而强制实施了产品改进。未来的工作应探索利用LLM嵌入模型和本地交叉编码器来提高零标签判别能力，同时避免增加用户负担。核心思想是系统应提供优先级建议而非直接决策。
AI.translation: 一个学术职位空缺可以吸引数百份申请，而第一轮筛选会消耗委员会大部分时间。我们描述了一个部署在国家学术职位空缺平台并与其空缺数据库集成的简历优先级排序器。它为一堆简历提出了一个阅读顺序，并将所有决策留给委员会，它将一个冻结的多语言Transformer编码器与一个每会话线性模型配对，该模型在每个标签后重新训练，并在会话结束时被丢弃。它确实有效：在一个包含300份合成简历的池中，委员会按照该工具的顺序阅读，在阅读一半简历后就能找到95%的相关候选人，而任意顺序则需要几乎全部阅读。本文是关于我们在审计该主张时发现的问题，而不是系统本身。三个发现改变了产品。结果表明，该池仅凭文档长度即可排序，这使得其上的精度型指标失去信息价值；在共享长度预算下重新生成该池消除了这一捷径，并使阅读深度结果依然成立。此类系统（包括我们的系统）报告的四级协议分数是固定阈值下的二元概率截断，因此它遵循分类器的置信度而非其排名，并随着标签的积累而下降。而不确定性采样，即实现“建议下一份简历”按钮的显而易见的方式，虽然保持了模型质量，但却使委员会的总阅读负荷高于无标签基线，因为它要求审查的简历正是那些原本会被跳过的简历。第四个结果显示了下一步的探索方向：一个托管的LLM嵌入模型在长度控制下将零标签序数判别能力从0.66提升到0.80，但在会话模型拥有二三十个标签后便不再重要；一个本地交叉编码器在不发送数据的情况下实现了相同的冷启动增益。我们报告了每个发现所强制实施的修复措施。
AI.summary: 本文审计了一个已部署的、用于学术职位申请初筛的简历优先级排序系统。该系统旨在通过提供阅读顺序而非直接决策来节省委员会时间。审计发现，最初的性能评估存在缺陷，例如合成数据集可被文档长度简单排序，以及协议评分机制的误导性。此外，不确定性采样虽然保持模型质量，但增加了用户阅读负担。研究还探索了使用LLM嵌入模型和本地交叉编码器来提升冷启动时的判别能力。最终，审计结果促使产品进行了多项改进，强调了在设计此类人机协作系统时，优先排序而非决策的重要性以及严格审计的必要性。
AI.keywords: 简历筛选, 人工智能辅助, 优先级排序, 系统审计, 人机协作
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过对一个已部署的HIL（Human-in-the-Loop）系统进行严格审计，提供了宝贵的实践经验和教训。其创新之处在于强调了“优先排序而非决策”的核心理念，并揭示了在实际应用中评估指标和交互设计可能存在的陷阱。论文指出的文档长度偏见、协议评分机制的局限性以及不确定性采样带来的额外负担，都对未来设计和评估HIL系统具有重要指导意义。同时，探索LLM嵌入模型作为冷启动解决方案也展现了前瞻性。这篇工作的重要性在于其从实际部署和审计的角度出发，为学术界和工业界提供了关于如何构建更健壮、更用户友好的智能辅助系统的深刻见解。

title: A Survey on the Use of Machine Learning within Computer Algebra
summary:
This survey explores the use of Machine Learning (ML) in the field of Computer Algebra (CA), both to optimise existing CA algorithms, and to perform symbolic computation directly. Traditional symbolic methods, while mathematically rigorous, often are computationally expensive thus limiting their use in real-world applications. Recent advances have shown that data-driven techniques can address these limitations by guiding heuristic decisions, selecting optimal algorithms, predicting structural properties of algebraic objects, or even making direct symbolic computations.
  We take a systematic literature review approach and uncover work in CA applications including cylindrical algebraic decomposition, Gröbner basis computation, symbolic integration, and many more. The survey compares the different ML approaches that have been employed for these tasks, ranging from decision trees to transformers. Issues uncovered by the survey include the lack of benchmark datasets for CA, which hinders the comparison of methods and the generalizability of ML models. The survey identifies the potential for explainable AI tools to help develop trust in decisions, and to drive forward CA research itself.

AI.title_translation: 机器学习在计算机代数中应用之综述
AI.tldr: 本文综述了机器学习在计算机代数中的应用，展示了数据驱动方法如何优化符号计算，并指出了数据集缺乏等当前挑战与未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 传统的符号方法虽然数学上严谨，但通常计算成本高昂，限制了其在实际应用中的使用，因此需要借助数据驱动的机器学习技术来克服这些局限性。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，梳理了圆柱代数分解、 Gröbner 基计算、符号积分等应用中的相关工作，并对比了从决策树到 Transformer 等不同的机器学习方法。
AI.result: 揭示了机器学习在计算机代数多个核心应用中的成功案例，指出了当前领域存在缺乏基准数据集、影响方法比较和模型泛化能力的问题。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习能有效缓解计算机代数中的计算瓶颈，但仍面临缺乏基准数据集等挑战，可解释人工智能在建立信任和推动研究方面具有巨大潜力。
AI.translation:
本综述探讨了机器学习（ML）在计算机代数（CA）领域的应用，既用于优化现有的CA算法，也用于直接执行符号计算。传统的符号方法虽然数学上严谨，但通常计算成本高昂，从而限制了它们在现实世界应用中的使用。最近的进展表明，数据驱动的技术可以通过指导启发式决策、选择最优算法、预测代数对象的结构属性，甚至进行直接的符号计算来解决这些局限性。
我们采用系统性文献综述的方法，发掘了CA应用中的相关工作，包括圆柱代数分解、Gröbner基计算、符号积分等。该综述比较了为这些任务所采用的不同ML方法，从决策树到Transformer不等。综述揭示的问题包括缺乏用于CA的基准数据集，这阻碍了方法的比较和ML模型的泛化能力。该综述指出了可解释AI工具在帮助建立对决策的信任以及推动CA研究本身方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文对机器学习在计算机代数中的应用进行了系统性综述，探讨了其在优化算法和直接进行符号计算方面的作用，总结了现有方法、面临的挑战（如缺乏基准数据集）以及可解释AI的未来潜力。
AI.keywords: 机器学习, 计算机代数, 符号计算, 系统性文献综述, 可解释人工智能
AI.comments: 该论文系统性地总结了机器学习在计算机代数领域的应用现状与挑战，对于推动符号计算与数据驱动方法的交叉研究具有重要参考价值。

title: TRACE-MAS: Diagnosing and Repairing Collaboration Failures in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on not only individual agent behaviors but also the interactions that connect agents, including message exchanges and task dependencies. Existing MAS safeguards mainly perform agent-level anomaly detection, which becomes insufficient when failures originate from agent interactions and detected anomalies do not necessarily reveal their true sources. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{TRACE-MAS}, a finer-grained framework for diagnosing and repairing MAS failures. TRACE-MAS learns normal collaborative execution patterns from benign trajectories and detects deviations in agent state changes, message transitions, and task dependency evolutions. It further identifies responsible execution elements through source-aware attribution and selects minimal interventions to restore collaboration while preserving task-critical capabilities. Experiments on five MAS benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE-MAS significantly improves root-cause localization accuracy by \textbf{60.2}\% and achieves consistent gains in task recovery over strong MAS safeguards.

AI.title_translation: TRACE-MAS：诊断和修复多智能体系统中的协作失败
AI.tldr: TRACE-MAS是一个针对多智能体系统中协作失败的诊断和修复框架，它通过学习正常协作模式、检测交互偏差、源感知归因和最小干预来显著提高故障定位准确性和任务恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体系统（MAS）安全防护主要进行智能体级别的异常检测，当故障源于智能体之间的交互时，这种方法不足以揭示故障的真正来源。
AI.method: TRACE-MAS框架通过从正常轨迹中学习协作执行模式，检测智能体状态变化、消息转换和任务依赖演变中的偏差。它通过源感知归因识别负责的执行元素，并选择最小干预措施来恢复协作。
AI.result: 在五个MAS基准测试中，TRACE-MAS将根本原因定位准确性显著提高了60.2%，并在任务恢复方面比强大的MAS安全防护实现了持续的提升。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-MAS通过提供更细粒度的诊断和修复机制，有效解决了多智能体系统中源于交互的协作失败问题，显著提升了故障定位和任务恢复能力。
AI.translation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）不仅依赖于单个智能体的行为，还依赖于连接智能体的交互，包括消息交换和任务依赖。现有的MAS安全防护主要进行智能体级别的异常检测，当故障源于智能体交互时，这种方法就显得不足，并且检测到的异常不一定能揭示其真实来源。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了\textbf{TRACE-MAS}，一个更细粒度的诊断和修复MAS故障的框架。TRACE-MAS从良性轨迹中学习正常的协作执行模式，并检测智能体状态变化、消息转换和任务依赖演变中的偏差。它通过源感知归因进一步识别负责的执行元素，并选择最小干预措施来恢复协作，同时保留任务关键能力。在五个MAS基准测试上的实验表明，TRACE-MAS将根本原因定位准确性显著提高了\textbf{60.2}\%，并在任务恢复方面比强大的MAS安全防护实现了持续的提升。
AI.summary: TRACE-MAS是一个针对基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）中协作失败的诊断和修复框架。它解决了现有安全防护在处理源于智能体交互的故障时的局限性，通过学习正常协作模式、检测交互偏差、进行源感知归因以及选择最小干预来提高故障定位准确性和任务恢复能力。实验证明其在多个基准测试中表现优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 协作失败, 故障诊断, 根本原因定位, 任务恢复
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一个创新的框架TRACE-MAS，专注于解决多智能体系统中由智能体间交互而非个体行为导致的协作失败。其细粒度的诊断方法，包括学习正常模式、检测偏差和源感知归因，以及最小干预策略，对于提升复杂MAS的鲁棒性和可靠性具有重要意义。特别是在LLM驱动的MAS日益普及的背景下，理解并修复交互层面的故障变得尤为关键。

title: Image Watermarking With Memory Across Reissuance
summary: Publishers often revise and reissue images, yet valid watermarks may persist on superseded releases or unapproved edits. Even a current release can contain regions last authorized at different revisions. We introduce and formalize reissuable provenance: determining an image's current, superseded, or unissued status and recovering each region's last authorized revision (its generation), with abstention when evidence is insufficient. Generational Stratigraphy Fields (GSF) combine watermark evidence with an authenticated live reference to the current release, enabling replacement or retirement without rewriting circulated copies. Each reissue freshly embeds new generation labels in approved regions and inherited labels elsewhere, preserving history without requiring old watermarks to survive successive edits. Our complete-output reissuance evaluation follows 480 histories through four releases, retaining each AI editor's entire output. GSF achieves 99.67% accuracy in classifying issued images as current or superseded and 94.09% recall of unissued edits. After three reissues, one generation map provides time and location: it recovers regional labels with 93.13% median accuracy and localizes the latest approved revision with 92.86% IoU. Regional labels remain readable under tested delivery transformations that impair issued-state recognition. Watermarks can thus express who issued an image, which release is authoritative now, and when each region was last authorized.

AI.title_translation: 跨重新发行具有记忆的图像水印技术
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为生成层序场的图像水印方法，能够在图像经历多次修订和重新发行时，准确追踪其当前状态以及各个区域的最后授权修订版本。
AI.motivation: 出版商经常修订和重新发行图像，但现有的水印在旧版本或未经批准的编辑上可能仍然存在，且当前的发行版也可能包含不同修订版本的区域。现有的方法难以有效确定图像及其各区域的当前、废弃或未发行状态以及最后授权的版本。
AI.method: 引入生成层序场（GSF），将水印证据与当前版本的认证实时引用相结合，在批准区域嵌入新的生成标签，并在其他区域继承标签，从而在不需要旧水印在连续编辑中存活的前提下保留历史信息。
AI.result: 在包含480个历史记录和四个版本的评估中，GSF实现分类已发行图像为当前或废弃状态的准确率达99.67%，未发行编辑的召回率为94.09%。在三次重新发行后，能以93.13%的中位准确率恢复区域标签，并以92.86%的IoU定位最新批准的修订版，同时区域标签在多种传输变换下保持可读。
AI.conclusion: 生成层序场（GSF）成功解决了多轮修订图像的溯源与版本识别问题，在分类准确率、未发行编辑的召回率以及区域标签恢复方面均表现优异，且对常规传输变换具有鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 出版商经常修订和重新发行图像，然而有效的数字水印可能会在被取代的版本或未批准的编辑上持续存在。甚至当前的发布版本也可能包含最后在不同修订版中授权的区域。我们引入并形式化了可重新发行溯源（reissuable provenance）：确定图像是当前、被取代还是未发布的状，并恢复每个区域最后授权的修订版（其生成代际），在证据不足时进行弃权。生成层序场（GSF）将水印证据与当前版本的认证实时引用相结合，实现替换或退役而无需重写已分发的副本。每一次重新发行都在批准的区域新鲜嵌入新的代际标签，并在其他地方继承标签，在不需要旧水印在连续编辑中存活的情况下保留历史。我们的完整输出重新发行评估通过四个版本追踪了480个历史记录，保留了每个AI编辑器的整个输出。GSF在将已发行图像分类为当前或被取代状态时达到了99.67%的准确率，对未发行编辑的召回率达到94.09%。在三次重新发行之后，一个代际图即可提供时间和位置信息：它以93.13%的中位准确率恢复区域标签，并以92.86%的IoU定位最新批准的修订版。区域标签在削弱已发行状态识别的经测试传输变换下依然保持可读。因此，水印可以表达谁发行了图像、哪个版本现在具有权威性，以及每个区域是什么时候最后获得授权的。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为生成层序场（GSF）的图像水印方法，用于解决图像多次修订和重新发行过程中的版本溯源问题。该方法能够在不需要旧水印存活于连续编辑中的前提下，准确识别图像及其各个区域的发行状态和最后授权修订版，并在测试的传输变换中表现出鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: Image Watermarking, Reissuable Provenance, Generational Stratigraphy Fields, Version Control, Content Authenticity
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了可重新发行溯源（reissuable provenance）的概念，解决了图像在多次修订和重新发行过程中水印追踪和版本控制的难题。通过生成层序场（GSF），它能够在不重写已分发副本的情况下，有效追踪图像当前、废弃状态以及各区域的最新授权版本，对于数字版权管理和内容真实性验证具有重要意义。

title: Training Language Models for Introspective Oversight
summary: Language models increasingly exhibit behaviors that are difficult to detect in transcripts, such as reward hacking, deception, and sycophancy. Asking the assistant follow-up questions about its actions is unreliable, since models are generally not trained to report their own misbehavior. As a result, approaches to oversight typically involve querying external models. These face limitations: external transcript monitoring operates only on visible model outputs, and activation decoders lack full context and are prone to confabulation. We introduce introspective oversight, which trains a new role in the model to answer arbitrary questions about the assistant, rewarding answers that are verified against the assistant's actual behavior. We implement this by adding a separate, third-person observer role that answers these queries, which we can train solely for accuracy and separately from the assistant. On five held-out oversight evaluations, an observer trained on Qwen3.6-27B obtains a mean AUROC of 0.907, outperforming honesty training (0.864), transcript monitoring (0.828), and activation oracles (0.796). We further find that training an observer makes the assistant itself easier to monitor, with every baseline method improving on average when applied to the fine-tuned assistant. These results suggest that training models to answer verifiable questions about themselves is a tractable approach to overseeing unintended behavior.

AI.title_translation: 训练语言模型进行内省式监督
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种“内省式监督”方法，通过训练模型中的一个独立观察者角色来回答关于助手模型的行为问题，从而提高对语言模型不当行为（如奖励劫持、欺骗）的检测能力，并取得了优异的效果。
AI.motivation: 语言模型日益展现出难以在文本记录中检测到的不当行为，例如奖励劫持、欺骗和奉承。传统的监督方法存在局限性：直接询问助手模型不可靠，外部文本记录监控只能作用于可见输出，而激活解码器缺乏完整上下文且容易编造。因此，需要一种更有效的方法来监督语言模型的非预期行为。
AI.method: 本文引入了“内省式监督”方法，即在模型中训练一个新的角色来回答关于助手模型的任意问题。该方法通过添加一个独立的、第三人称的“观察者”角色来实现，该角色专门训练以确保其回答的准确性，并与助手模型分开训练。观察者的回答会根据助手模型的实际行为进行验证和奖励。
AI.result: 在五项留出监督评估中，基于Qwen3.6-27B训练的观察者获得了0.907的平均AUROC，优于诚实训练（0.864）、文本记录监控（0.828）和激活预言机（0.796）。此外，训练观察者还使得助手模型本身更容易被监控，所有基线方法在应用于经过微调的助手模型时平均都有所改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，训练模型回答关于自身的可验证问题是一种有效且可行的监督非预期行为的方法。
AI.translation: 语言模型日益展现出难以在文本记录中检测到的行为，例如奖励劫持、欺骗和奉承。询问助手模型关于其行为的后续问题是不可靠的，因为模型通常没有被训练来报告自己的不当行为。因此，监督方法通常涉及查询外部模型。这些方法面临局限性：外部文本记录监控仅作用于可见的模型输出，而激活解码器缺乏完整上下文且容易编造。我们引入了内省式监督，它在模型中训练一个新的角色来回答关于助手模型的任意问题，并奖励那些与助手模型实际行为相符的答案。我们通过添加一个独立的、第三人称的观察者角色来实现这一点，该角色回答这些查询，我们可以只为准确性而训练它，并与助手模型分开。在五项留出监督评估中，基于Qwen3.6-27B训练的观察者获得了0.907的平均AUROC，优于诚实训练（0.864）、文本记录监控（0.828）和激活预言机（0.796）。我们进一步发现，训练观察者使得助手模型本身更容易被监控，所有基线方法在应用于经过微调的助手模型时平均都有所改进。这些结果表明，训练模型回答关于自身的可验证问题是一种监督非预期行为的可行方法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“内省式监督”的新方法，旨在解决语言模型（LLMs）中难以检测的奖励劫持、欺骗等不当行为。该方法通过在LLM中训练一个独立的、第三人称的“观察者”角色，使其能够准确回答关于助手模型行为的问题，并根据助手模型的实际行为验证观察者的回答。实验结果显示，内省式监督在检测LLM不当行为方面的AUROC达到0.907，显著优于传统的诚实训练、文本记录监控和激活预言机等方法。此外，训练观察者还提高了助手模型本身的可监控性。这表明训练模型回答关于自身的可验证问题是监督LLM非预期行为的有效途径。
AI.keywords: 语言模型, 内省式监督, 不当行为检测, 观察者模型, 模型可解释性
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一种新颖且富有前景的语言模型监督方法。其创新之处在于引入了独立的“观察者”角色，将监督任务从助手模型本身分离出来，并通过验证观察者的回答来提高检测准确性。这对于解决大型语言模型日益复杂的“黑箱”行为问题具有重要意义。该方法不仅提高了不当行为的检测率，还能间接提升被监督模型的透明度和可控性，为未来构建更安全、更可靠的AI系统提供了新的思路。

title: Where the Tokens Go: Heat, Entropy and Error in Agentic Coding
comments: 43 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables; includes supplementary information with 3 further figures
summary: Coding agents are billed by the token, yet software engineering says nothing about what a token actually buys. Here we introduce a theory of software thermodynamics. The theory draws analogues from classical and stochastic thermodynamics, extends them, and applies them to modern agentic coding. We count the tokens an agent generates as its cost and divide that cost into work and heat. The test suite acts as a software Maxwell's daemon that judges every coding change. We test the theory with an analogue of the experiments in which a single molecule is pulled open and let fold again: an agent makes a change to a repository (coding) and then undoes it (uncoding), many times over, and we count the tokens of every model call. The cycle returns the requested edits to where they began, with each direction started from a stored reference tree, and the spread of its cost over repeated cycles defines a software temperature, which rose with the sampling temperature of the model. About 80 per cent of the tokens of a successful run are generated in model calls that leave the requested change where it was, and we call these tokens heat. The free energy of a change, which we estimate by analogy with the equality of Jarzynski, is 14 to 22 per cent of the mean cost of a successful coding run. Coding costs 1.1 to 1.5 times as much as uncoding. The daemon is imperfect: the verdict of a test suite varies with its environment, and a suite that accepts a broken change has a cost in tokens. The practical implication of the proposed theory could be new tools for analysing and optimising coding agents through the lens of thermodynamics.
comment: 43 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables; includes supplementary information with 3 further figures

AI.title_translation: Token何去何从：智能体编程中的热量、熵和错误
AI.tldr: 本文引入了软件热力学理论，将智能体编程的token成本分为功和热，并通过类比实验发现大部分token用于“热量”生成，并提出该理论可用于优化智能体编程工具。
AI.motivation: 编程智能体按token计费，但目前尚不清楚一个token实际购买了什么。本文旨在通过引入软件热力学理论来理解智能体编程的token成本。
AI.method: 本文提出了软件热力学理论，借鉴并扩展了经典和随机热力学。将智能体生成的token计为成本，并将其分为功和热。通过模拟单一分子拉伸和折叠的实验，让智能体多次进行编码和撤销编码操作，并记录每次模型调用的token数量。测试套件被视为软件麦克斯韦妖来评估代码更改。
AI.result: 成功的运行中约80%的token是在模型调用中生成的，这些调用使请求的更改保持原样，被称为“热量”。一次更改的自由能约为成功编码运行平均成本的14%到22%。编码成本是撤销编码的1.1到1.5倍。测试套件（麦克斯韦妖）并不完美，接受错误更改的套件会产生token成本。软件温度随模型采样温度的升高而升高。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的软件热力学理论为分析和优化智能体编程工具提供了新的视角。通过该理论，可以更好地理解智能体编程中的token成本分配，特别是“热量”的产生，并可能开发出新的优化工具。
AI.translation:
Token何去何从：智能体编程中的热量、熵和错误

编程智能体按token计费，然而软件工程并未说明一个token实际购买了什么。本文引入了软件热力学理论。该理论借鉴并扩展了经典和随机热力学，并将其应用于现代智能体编程。我们将智能体生成的token计为成本，并将该成本分为功和热。测试套件充当软件麦克斯韦妖，判断每一次编码更改。我们通过类比实验来验证该理论，该实验模拟了单一分子被拉开又折叠的循环：一个智能体对代码库进行更改（编码），然后撤销更改（撤销编码），重复多次，我们记录每次模型调用的token数量。该循环使请求的编辑回到起点，每个方向都从存储的参考树开始，其成本在重复循环中的扩散定义了软件温度，该温度随模型的采样温度升高而升高。一次成功运行中约80%的token是在模型调用中生成的，这些调用使请求的更改保持原样，我们称这些token为热量。一次更改的自由能（通过类比雅辛斯基等式估算）是成功编码运行平均成本的14%到22%。编码成本是撤销编码的1.1到1.5倍。该“妖”并不完美：测试套件的判断会随其环境而变化，接受错误更改的套件会产生token成本。所提出理论的实际意义可能是通过热力学视角分析和优化编程智能体的新工具。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种软件热力学理论，用于分析智能体编程中的token成本。该理论将智能体生成的token成本划分为“功”和“热”，并通过实验发现，在成功运行中，约80%的token消耗于未能推进代码修改的“热量”生成。研究还量化了编码与撤销编码的成本差异，并指出测试套件作为“软件麦克斯韦妖”的局限性。该理论为开发新的工具以优化和分析智能体编程提供了潜力。
AI.keywords: 智能体编程, 软件热力学, token成本, 热量, 麦克斯韦妖
AI.comments: 这项研究创新性地将热力学概念引入到智能体编程的成本分析中，提供了一个全新的视角来理解和量化编程智能体的效率。将token消耗区分为“功”和“热”的概念非常直观且具有启发性，尤其指出了大部分token消耗在“热量”上，这对于优化智能体行为具有重要指导意义。该理论为未来的智能体编程工具开发和成本效益分析奠定了基础，具有重要的实践价值。

title: Chorus: Shared N-gram Embeddings with Layer-wise Adaptation
summary: Language models can gain capacity at little computational cost from n-gram embedding tables: large tables of learned vectors for short sequences of consecutive tokens, which are looked up and added to the model's input or to its intermediate layers. Recent designs commonly use a separate n-gram embedding table for each layer, which makes the tables costly in memory and prevents layers from sharing what they learn. Sharing a single table, however, gives every layer the same embedding and leaves no room for layer-wise preferences, and it performs poorly in practice. We propose Chorus, in which one set of n-gram embedding tables serves the whole network and every layer reads it in its own way. Each layer maps the refined embedding through its own projection layer, after rescaling its components by factors computed from its current hidden state. Chorus matches the quality of existing n-gram methods with 87% smaller tables: with 1.2B table parameters it predicts text better than FactorEngram and DeepSeek's Engram do with 9.6B. It outperforms Engram, TN-gram and FactorEngram in every setting where we compared them, across table sizes from 20M to 9.6B parameters. We also show that the recently proposed memory-efficient optimizer Ember works well with Chorus, saving 99.2% of table-optimizer memory compared with AdamW without degrading training performance. These results enable further scaling of n-gram embedding tables along the table-size axis by reducing memory use and allowing shared knowledge to be reused across layers.

AI.title_translation: Chorus：具有逐层自适应的共享 N 元语法嵌入
AI.tldr: Chorus 提出了一种跨层共享的 n-gram 嵌入表与逐层自适应机制，在大幅减少内存和参数的同时，显著提升了语言模型的文本预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的 n-gram 嵌入表设计通常为每层使用单独的表，导致内存成本高昂且无法共享知识；而简单地共享单个表则无法适应不同层的偏好且性能较差。为此需要一种既能共享知识又能适应逐层偏好的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Chorus 方法，使整个网络共享一套 n-gram 嵌入表，并通过每一层的隐藏状态计算重标定因子，再利用各自的投影层将精炼后的嵌入映射到特定层中。
AI.result: Chorus 在表大小缩小 87% 的情况下达到了现有 n-gram 方法的质量；仅用 1.2B 的表参数就比拥有 9.6B 参数的 FactorEngram 和 DeepSeek Engram 预测效果更好，并在各种设置下全面超越 Engram、TN-gram 和 FactorEngram。
AI.conclusion: Chorus 成功实现了在全网络中共享同一组 n-gram 嵌入表并通过逐层自适应满足不同层的偏好，在大幅减少参数量和内存的同时，显著超越了现有各种 n-gram 嵌入方法的性能。
AI.translation: 语言模型可以通过 n-gram 嵌入表以极小的计算成本获得容量提升：即针对短连续 token 序列的大型学习向量表，这些向量被检索并加到模型的输入或中间层。近期的设计通常为每一层使用单独的 n-gram 嵌入表，这使得嵌入表在内存上代价高昂，并阻止了各层之间共享所学知识。然而，共享单个表会给每一层提供相同的嵌入，没有留出逐层偏好的空间，并且在实践中表现不佳。我们提出了 Chorus，其中一组 n-gram 嵌入表服务于整个网络，并且每一层都以自己的方式读取它。在通过当前隐藏状态计算出的因子对其组件进行重新缩放后，每一层通过其自己的投影层映射精炼后的嵌入。Chorus 在表大小减小 87% 的情况下匹配了现有 n-gram 方法的质量：拥有 1.2B 表参数时，它的文本预测效果优于具有 9.6B 参数的 FactorEngram 和 DeepSeek 的 Engram。在从 20M 到 9.6B 参数的表大小的各种设置中，它在与 Engram、TN-gram 和 FactorEngram 的比较中均表现更优。我们还表明，最近提出的内存高效优化器 Ember 可以与 Chorus 很好地配合使用，与 AdamW 相比，在不降低训练性能的情况下节省了 99.2% 的表优化器内存。这些结果通过减少内存使用并允许共享知识跨层重用，实现了 n-gram 嵌入表沿表大小轴的进一步扩展。
AI.summary: Chorus 是一种用于语言模型的共享 n-gram 嵌入与逐层自适应方法。它通过在整个网络中共享一套 n-gram 嵌入表，并结合逐层自适应投影和隐藏状态重标定机制，在大幅节省内存和参数量的同时，显著提升了文本预测性能。
AI.keywords: 语言模型, N-gram嵌入, 逐层自适应, 内存优化, 共享嵌入表
AI.comments: Chorus 通过引入逐层自适应投影和重标定机制，解决了传统 n-gram 嵌入表在“独立使用时内存开销大”与“共享时缺乏灵活性”之间的矛盾。该方法在大幅减少模型内存占用的同时提升了预测性能，对大语言模型的扩展具有重要意义。

title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
summary: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.

AI.title_translation: QDA：基于智能体的闭环大语言模型量化设计
AI.tldr: QDA利用大模型智能体自动化设计高效的量化方案，通过快速评估和兼容的PTQ方法库，显著提升了低精度大语言模型的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的后训练量化方案针对不同模型和精度需要专家手工重新设计，耗时且次优；而使用智能体自动搜索则面临评估耗时长（推理成本高）以及不同PTQ方法库不兼容新架构的挑战。
AI.method: 提出QDA系统，包含一个兼容性PTQ方法库和一个基于KL散度的快速评估代理，通过闭环迭代搜索最优量化方案。
AI.result: 在四个推理模型上，QDA在W4A16、W4A8和W3A16精度下平均准确率分别比最强公开方案提升0.9、1.4和2.2个百分点；在320B参数的MoE模型GLM-5.3-Flash上恢复了98.3%的FP8准确率。
AI.conclusion: QDA通过结合高效评估代理和兼容性PTQ库，成功实现了全自动、高效且高性能的大模型量化设计。
AI.translation: 后训练量化是以低成本部署大语言模型的标准方法。然而，最佳的量化方案因模型和精度的不同而异。因此，专家必须为每个新模型重新设计方案，这既耗时又往往不是最优的。幸运的是，大语言模型智能体可以通过在多轮构建和评估候选方案的过程中不断改进方案来接管这一设计任务，从而使得更多的轮次带来更好的方案。然而，评估一个量化的推理模型需要数十个GPU小时，而且将不同代码库的方法结合起来意味着需要手动将每种方法移植到新架构中。我们提出了QDA，这是一个智能体为每个模型和精度设计量化方案的系统。为了加快评估速度，QDA在几分钟内通过计算候选模型在智能体未见过的推理轨迹上与原模型的输出KL散度来对每个候选进行评分，并通过长文本生成来检查有潜力的候选，以捕捉诸如重复循环之类的失败。为了加快构建速度，QDA提供了一个公开的PTQ方法库，这些方法彼此兼容，且兼容新的模型架构。在四个推理模型上，QDA在W4A16、W4A8和W3A16精度下，平均准确率分别比最强公开方案提升了0.9、1.4和2.2个百分点，每次搜索消耗64个GPU小时。在320B参数的MoE模型GLM-5.3-Flash的NVFP4 W4A4精度下，它恢复了FP8模型98.3%的准确率，而最佳厂商检查点的这一数字为96.9%。每个QDA检查点都可以在现有的推理内核上运行，且没有推理开销。我们将发布该库、评估器和评测工具。
AI.summary: QDA是一个基于智能体的闭环大模型量化设计系统。它通过提供兼容的新架构PTQ方法库和基于未见推理轨迹KL散度的快速评估机制，自动化地为不同模型和精度寻找最优量化方案，实现了高性能与高效率。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 后训练量化, LLM智能体, KL散度评估
AI.comments: QDA通过闭环智能体自动化大模型的量化设计，显著提升了低精度量化下的模型准确率，并大幅降低了人工设计和评估的开销。

title: Lossless Reversible Watermarking for AIGC with Applications in Authentication
summary: AIGC watermarking is commonly used for tracing, but it can also support applications such as authentication and tampering detection. We study lossless reversible watermarking, which enables exact recovery of the original watermarked image after permissible distortions. By exploiting the relatively low entropy of the information required for image generation, together with robust latent-space watermarking, we design a framework that preserves sufficient information for lossless recovery. We then apply the framework to AIGC authentication, which generally faces two key challenges. First, the authentication mechanism must resist adaptive adversaries. Second, the content relevant to authentication, such as visual designs or expressed messages, may depend on application requirements that are not known at generation time. To solve these difficulties, we incorporate cryptographic message authentication to provide unforgeability against adaptive attacks. Lossless recovery provides the original image as reference evidence, after which a suitable analyzer can be selected to make the authentication decision. Experiments on Stable Diffusion demonstrate exact recovery under a wide range of distortions.

AI.title_translation: 用于AIGC的无损可逆水印及其在认证中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种用于AIGC的无损可逆水印框架，该框架利用生成信息和鲁棒的潜在空间水印，实现了在允许失真后的原始图像精确恢复，并将其应用于对抗自适应攻击的AIGC认证。
AI.motivation: AIGC水印通常用于追踪，但也可支持认证和篡改检测等应用。本文旨在解决AIGC认证中的两个关键挑战：抵抗自适应对手和处理生成时未知的内容相关认证需求。
AI.method: 本文设计了一个无损可逆水印框架，通过利用图像生成所需信息的较低熵和鲁棒的潜在空间水印，保留了足够的信息以实现无损恢复。该框架结合了密码学消息认证以抵抗自适应攻击，并利用无损恢复的原始图像作为参考证据进行认证决策。
AI.result: 实验证明，在多种失真条件下，基于Stable Diffusion的实现能够实现精确恢复。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种用于AIGC的无损可逆水印框架，它通过精确恢复原始图像并结合密码学消息认证，有效解决了AIGC认证中对抗自适应攻击和处理未知认证内容的挑战。
AI.translation: AIGC水印通常用于追踪，但它也可以支持认证和篡改检测等应用。我们研究了无损可逆水印，它能够在允许的失真后精确恢复原始水印图像。通过利用图像生成所需信息的相对较低熵，结合鲁棒的潜在空间水印，我们设计了一个框架，该框架保留了足够的信息以实现无损恢复。然后，我们将该框架应用于AIGC认证，这通常面临两个关键挑战。首先，认证机制必须抵抗自适应对手。其次，与认证相关的内容，例如视觉设计或表达的消息，可能取决于在生成时未知的应用要求。为了解决这些困难，我们结合了密码学消息认证，以提供抵抗自适应攻击的不可伪造性。无损恢复提供了原始图像作为参考证据，之后可以选择合适的分析器来做出认证决定。在Stable Diffusion上的实验证明了在各种失真下都能实现精确恢复。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对AIGC的无损可逆水印框架，旨在解决AIGC认证中的挑战。该框架利用生成信息的低熵和鲁棒的潜在空间水印，实现在允许失真后精确恢复原始图像。为抵抗自适应攻击，该方法结合了密码学消息认证。实验证明，该框架在Stable Diffusion上能在多种失真下实现原始图像的精确恢复，为AIGC认证提供了一种有效的解决方案。
AI.keywords: AIGC, 无损可逆水印, 认证, 潜在空间水印, 密码学消息认证
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的无损可逆水印方法，特别适用于AIGC认证场景。其核心创新在于结合了生成信息的低熵特性和鲁棒的潜在空间水印技术，实现了在存在失真情况下的原始图像精确恢复。此外，通过整合密码学消息认证，有效增强了认证机制的安全性，使其能够抵抗自适应攻击，解决了AIGC认证中的关键挑战。这项工作对于AIGC内容的真实性验证和版权保护具有重要意义，尤其是在数字内容日益普及的今天。

title: Which Tokens, in What Order, and How Fast? A Theoretical Analysis of On-Policy Distillation Objectives
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model to match a teacher model based on its own generations. When using OPD, one must choose whether to apply it at the sequence or token level and which divergence to minimize. However, despite the wide adoption of OPD in practice, the formal understanding of which OPD objective is appropriate for a given setting is limited. Toward addressing this gap, we theoretically analyze how the choice of OPD objective governs which tokens are prioritized, in what order, and how efficiently. Our analysis reveals that sequence-level OPD exhibits a future agreement bias, which myopic token-level objectives avoid. This bias induces a reverse learning order, in which sequence-level OPD first matches the teacher at later token positions, while at earlier positions it can favor tokens that are improbable under the teacher, and thus often undesirable. As for the choice of divergence, we prove that it strongly influences the amenability of OPD to gradient-based optimization. In particular, while the forward KL divergence enjoys a well-behaved objective landscape, other $f$-divergences, such as reverse KL, can suffer from vanishing gradients even when the student and teacher are far apart. Across language model post-training settings, we demonstrate the implications of these theoretical findings for which OPD objective is preferable, highlighting the importance of accounting for the interplay between the student, teacher, and task at hand.

AI.title_translation: 哪些Token，以何种顺序，以及多快？策略蒸馏目标函数的理论分析
AI.tldr: 理论分析表明，策略蒸馏中选择目标函数会影响token优先级、学习顺序和效率。序列级OPD有未来一致性偏差，导致反向学习顺序；前向KL散度优化效果好，而其他f-散度可能面临梯度消失问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管策略蒸馏（OPD）在实践中被广泛采用，但对于在给定设置下哪种OPD目标函数是合适的，缺乏正式的理解。本文旨在通过理论分析来解决这一空白，探讨OPD目标函数的选择如何影响token的优先级、学习顺序和效率。
AI.method: 本文通过理论分析了策略蒸馏（OPD）目标函数的选择如何影响token的优先级、学习顺序和效率。
AI.result: 理论分析揭示，序列级OPD存在未来一致性偏差，而短视的token级目标函数则避免了这一点。这种偏差导致了反向学习顺序，即序列级OPD首先匹配较晚的token位置，而在较早位置可能偏爱在教师模型下不太可能且通常不理想的token。关于散度选择，研究证明它强烈影响OPD对基于梯度的优化的适应性。特别是，前向KL散度具有良好的目标函数景观，而其他f-散度（如反向KL）即使学生和教师模型相距很远，也可能遭受梯度消失的问题。
AI.conclusion: 这些理论发现对于语言模型后训练环境中哪种OPD目标函数更优具有重要意义，强调了考虑学生模型、教师模型和当前任务之间相互作用的重要性。
AI.translation: 策略蒸馏（OPD）通过学生语言模型根据其自身的生成来匹配教师模型。在使用OPD时，必须选择是在序列级别还是在token级别应用它，以及最小化哪种散度。然而，尽管OPD在实践中被广泛采用，但对于在给定设置下哪种OPD目标函数是合适的，缺乏正式的理解。为了解决这一空白，我们理论分析了OPD目标函数的选择如何控制token的优先级、学习顺序以及效率。我们的分析揭示，序列级OPD表现出一种未来一致性偏差，而短视的token级目标函数则避免了这种偏差。这种偏差导致了反向学习顺序，即序列级OPD首先在较晚的token位置匹配教师模型，而在较早位置，它可能偏爱在教师模型下不太可能且因此通常不理想的token。至于散度的选择，我们证明它强烈影响OPD对基于梯度的优化的适应性。特别是，前向KL散度具有良好的目标函数景观，而其他f-散度（如反向KL）即使学生和教师模型相距很远，也可能遭受梯度消失的问题。在语言模型后训练设置中，我们展示了这些理论发现对于哪种OPD目标函数更优的含义，强调了考虑学生模型、教师模型和当前任务之间相互作用的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文对策略蒸馏（OPD）目标函数进行了理论分析，探讨了在序列级或token级应用以及选择何种散度最小化时，目标函数如何影响token优先级、学习顺序和效率。研究发现，序列级OPD存在未来一致性偏差，导致反向学习顺序，即首先匹配后面的token，而前面的token可能不理想。此外，前向KL散度在梯度优化中表现良好，而反向KL等f-散度可能遭遇梯度消失问题。这些发现为语言模型后训练中选择合适的OPD目标函数提供了指导，强调了考虑模型和任务之间相互作用的重要性。
AI.keywords: 策略蒸馏, 理论分析, 语言模型, KL散度, 梯度消失
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过深入的理论分析，揭示了策略蒸馏（OPD）中关键设计选择（如应用级别和散度类型）的深层影响，填补了实践与理论理解之间的空白。其关于未来一致性偏差和梯度消失问题的发现，为优化OPD的训练过程提供了重要的理论依据，具有较高的创新性和实践指导价值。

title: HardwareDx: A Foundational Graph Model System for Datacenter Machine Repairs
summary:
The rapid scale-up of AI infrastructure has made datacenter reliability a cornerstone of the cloud business economy. Since hardware failures in hyper-scale AI clusters can stall multi-million dollar training workloads, the downtime of individual machines can cause outsized economic losses. Minimizing machine downtime, therefore, is more important than ever.
  To address this, we present Hardware Diagnoser (HardwareDx), an AI-driven hardware diagnosis system that applies a graph foundation model approach to automated datacenter maintenance. It allows a single model to diagnose many platforms and accelerate onboarding of new hardware products. Deployed at production scale at Google, HardwareDx yields substantial efficiency gains across diverse compute architectures. Real-world evaluations demonstrate that it reduces production downtime by 18.3% on GPU platforms and 16.1% on TPUs. Furthermore, it significantly accelerates hardware deployment, cutting quality assurance (QA) time by 28.3% for GPUs and 25.1% for TPUs. These results establish HardwareDx as a field-tested solution for maximizing the reliability and cost efficiency of next generation AI fleets.

AI.title_translation: HardwareDx：用于数据中心机器维修的基础图模型系统
AI.tldr: HardwareDx是一个基于图基础模型的AI数据中心硬件诊断系统，通过自动化维护显著降低了GPU和TPU平台的停机时间并加速了硬件部署。
AI.motivation: 随着AI基础设施的快速扩张，数据中心硬件故障会导致高昂的经济损失，因此迫切需要最小化机器停机时间以保障云业务经济。
AI.method: 采用基于图基础模型的方法（Graph Foundation Model Approach）构建自动化数据中心维护和硬件诊断系统。
AI.result: 在Google的生产规模部署中，GPU平台的生产停机时间减少了18.3%，TPU平台减少了16.1%；同时质量保证（QA）时间分别缩短了28.3%（GPU）和25.1%（TPU）。
AI.conclusion: HardwareDx是一个经过实战检验的解决方案，能有效最大化下一代AI集群的可靠性和成本效益。
AI.translation:
人工智能基础设施的快速扩张使得数据中心可靠性成为云业务经济的基石。由于超大规模AI集群中的硬件故障可能会使价值数百万美元的训练工作负载停滞，单台机器的停机可能会造成巨大的经济损失。因此，尽量减少机器停机时间比以往任何时候都更加重要。
为了解决这个问题，我们提出了硬件诊断器（HardwareDx），这是一个AI驱动的硬件诊断系统，它应用图基础模型方法来进行自动化数据中心维护。它允许单个模型诊断许多平台并加速新硬件产品的上线。HardwareDx在Google的生产规模上部署，在各种计算架构上产生了显著的效率提升。真实世界的评估表明，它将GPU平台的生产停机时间减少了18.3%，TPU平台的生产停机时间减少了16.1%。此外，它显著加速了硬件部署，将GPU的质量保证（QA）时间缩短了28.3%，将TPU的质量保证时间缩短了25.1%。这些结果确立了HardwareDx作为一种经过实战检验的解决方案，能够最大化下一代AI集群的可靠性和成本效益。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了HardwareDx，一个用于数据中心机器维修的图基础模型系统。通过在多个计算架构上应用单一模型进行自动硬件诊断，该系统在Google的生产环境中大幅减少了停机时间并加速了新硬件的部署。
AI.keywords: 数据中心可靠性, 图基础模型, 硬件诊断, 人工智能基础设施, 自动化维护
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于图基础模型的硬件诊断系统，成功应用于Google的大规模AI数据中心。其创新之处在于能够跨多种硬件平台进行统一诊断，大幅缩短了机器停机时间和硬件部署周期，对超大规模AI基础设施的可靠性具有重要意义。

title: Tracking Representations in LLM Reasoning Traces for Iterated Games
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents achieve state-of-the-art performance across domains through chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Despite their ubiquitous use, little is understood about the relationship between the externalized trace and the model's actual computation. We address this by investigating how LLM agents make decisions in iterative games with incomplete information. Using a series of mechanistic interpretability techniques, we find that the model forms and iteratively revises an internal representation of the game throughout the CoT. Once the model prematurely commits to an incorrect belief, it rarely recovers. This failure is manifested in both the literal trace and the layer activations. Ultimately, as multi-agent systems are more prevalent, our work opens the door to a more focused diagnosis of their strategic reasoning errors. For illustrative purposes, we offer an interactive visualizer of our methodology on selected sample traces at https://interp-self.github.io/gametrace/

AI.title_translation: 迭代博弈中大语言模型推理轨迹的表征追踪
AI.tldr: 通过机械可解释性技术追踪大语言模型在迭代博弈思维链中的内部表征，揭示了其错误信念难以纠正的现象。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型通过思维链取得了最先进的性能，但关于其外部化推理轨迹与模型实际计算之间的关系仍缺乏了解。
AI.method: 使用一系列机械可解释性技术追踪大语言模型在不完全信息迭代博弈中的决策过程与层激活情况。
AI.result: 模型在思维链中会迭代修正游戏内部表征；一旦过早承诺于错误信念则很难恢复，该失败会同时体现在字面轨迹和层激活中。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在多轮博弈中会形成并迭代修正内部表征，但一旦过早陷入错误信念则难以恢复，这在思维链和层激活中均有体现。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过思维链（CoT）推理在各个领域取得了最先进的性能。尽管它们被广泛使用，但人们对外部化轨迹与模型实际计算之间的关系知之甚少。我们通过研究LLM智能体在信息不完全的迭代博弈中如何做决策来解决这个问题。使用一系列机械可解释性技术，我们发现模型在整个CoT过程中形成并迭代修正游戏的内部表征。一旦模型过早地承诺了一个错误的信念，它就很少能恢复过来。这种失败表现在文字轨迹和层激活中。最终，随着多智能体系统越来越普遍，我们的工作为更集中地诊断其战略推理错误打开了大门。为了说明起见，我们在https://interp-self.github.io/gametrace/上提供了所选样本轨迹的方法的交互式可视化工具。
AI.summary: 本文通过机械可解释性技术研究了大语言模型在不完全信息迭代博弈中的决策机制，发现模型在思维链中会迭代更新内部表征，但过早的错误信念会导致不可恢复的推理失败。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 思维链, 机械可解释性, 迭代博弈, 内部表征
AI.comments: 该研究通过机械可解释性技术揭示了大语言模型在迭代博弈中思维链背后的内部表征机制，对于理解多智能体系统的战略推理错误具有重要意义。

title: RFBench: A Simulator-Grounded Multimodal Benchmark for Passive RF Layout Design and Understanding
summary: While multimodal language models can interpret diagrams and generate structured outputs, their capacity to connect passive radio-frequency (RF) design intent, layout geometry, and electromagnetic behavior remains largely untested. To address this gap, we introduce RFBench, a simulator-grounded dataset and benchmark for passive RF layout design and understanding. The dataset contains 10,000 two-port planar layouts simulated using ADS Momentum, with each layout represented by editable geometric primitives, a raster image, a 16x16 occupancy grid, complex S-parameters at 201 frequency points, a structural category, and an RF response label. Building on these aligned representations, we define seven tasks spanning specification-conditioned layout generation, representation translation, response prediction, simulator-based validation, design diagnosis and improvement, structural understanding, and response classification. Extensive baselines across seven multimodal language models reveal systematic weaknesses in generating structurally valid layouts and predicting electromagnetically faithful responses. We show that RF-specific fine-tuning increases T1a structural validity from 0.0% to 83.2% and the T3 primitive-input within-2-dB rate from 17.7% to 62.8%, demonstrating the value of domain adaptation while leaving considerable room for further progress. RFBench establishes a common testbed for evaluating multimodal RF capabilities and guiding the development of models that connect design intent and layout representations with physical behavior.

title: Incremental Roseland: Batch-wise Landmark Diffusion via Kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Loève Update
summary: Landmark diffusion (Roseland) computes a diffusion-map-style spectral embedding from the singular value decomposition of a degree-normalized data-to-landmark kernel matrix, at a cost far below that of full diffusion maps. It assumes, however, that all data are available at once. We introduce incremental Roseland (iRoseland), which casts the landmark affinity as a row-growing matrix whose SVD can be updated with a kernelized Sequential Karhunen--Loève (SKL) scheme. Degre correction is handled by a first order expansion about a reference mean kernel row and so that the landmark-side eigenbasis may be recovered from a single landmark-by-landmark eigendecomposition at each step. The presented method requires only a single pass over the data and runs in bounded-memory with state independent of the number of points processed. A forgetting factor lets the method track drifting distributions, and a sample-size-invariant embedding keeps outputs comparable across time. Experiments show agreement with Roseland to round-off on stationary data, and accuracy that exceeds equal-memory Roseland by an order of magnitude on long streams. On drifting data, we observe large gains from forgetting with a window matched to the drift.

title: Verifiably Safe Decentralized Control via Event-Triggered Topology Switching
summary: This paper proposes a decentralized event-triggered topology-switching protocol for multi-agent systems under estimation uncertainty. We consider an intermittent communication setting in which each agent switches between connected and disconnected modes and makes communication decisions using locally computable certificates, while the closed-loop state is required to remain safe. The proposed protocol follows a safety-driven triggering principle in which agents reconnect before their certificates reach the safety boundary and disconnect only after recovering to a stricter bound below the safety limit. Our design enables intermittent connectivity while maintaining the estimation error within a certified safety bound and excluding Zeno behavior. We evaluate the proposed protocol on a quadruple-tank example, showing that it keeps all tank deviations within the safety bound while allowing agents to remain disconnected for most of the run.

title: OCLDA-GS: Object-Centric Local Deformation-Aware Gaussian Streaming
summary: Streaming 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for online reconstruction of dynamic scenes from multi-view videos for Free Viewpoint Video (FVV). Current time and storage efficient methods rely on selecting a subset of anchor Gaussians and neighborhood interpolation for fast streamable 3DGS. However, these methods can overlook object-specific motion and introduce inconsistencies near object boundaries. We propose OCLDA-GS, an object-centric streaming framework that dynamically reallocates object and motion-aware Gaussian anchors to allocate anchor Gaussian support for objects undergoing large motion while at the same time, restricting the gaussian neighborhood within object groups for more precise object boundaries. Furthermore, it estimates object-wise rigid transformations (e.g. a hand moving) and leverages these estimates to learn per-anchor local deformation correction for small deformations (e.g. wrinkles on a shirt). Then, we conduct experiments on three dynamic multi-view video datasets and demonstrate improvements over the previous baselines alongside improved quality between refinement timesteps. Under matched refinement budgets, our method improves PSNR over Instant Gaussian Stream (IGS) by 0.169 dB on N3DV, 0.202 dB on Meeting Room and +0.199 on Google Immersive, while reducing the mean PSNR drop between refinement timesteps by 9.2% and 13.8% in N3DV and Meeting Room, respectively.

title: Autoregressive View Model
summary: We present the Autoregressive View Model (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation. Through a unified in-context interface, AVM conditions on images or videos to generate short clips along a requested camera path. Visual context grounds reconstruction and interpolation, while a learned prior enables extrapolation into unseen regions. AVM retrieves relevant views from inputs and generated history to form a bounded active context. We fine-tune a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion transformer with flow matching in an N-in-1-out formulation. We then tune a causal model on its own rollouts to improve photorealism, reduce denoising steps, and limit long-horizon drift. We scale training to approximately 8M scenes and video clips. We evaluate generation capacity and scene persistence across benchmarks for camera control, text control, visual quality, dynamics, sparse and 4D reconstruction, and long-horizon consistency. The results demonstrate that AVM adapts to diverse input and output settings through one in-context interface.

title: Record Sufficiency: What a Decision Record Must Preserve When an Unsettled Claim Becomes an Operative Status
comments: 24 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Ancillary files: schema, records, checks, 25 real statements of reasons with protocol and coding, and a one-command reproduction script
summary: Organisations keep evidence, logs and approvals, but often not the step by which an unsettled claim became an operative status, such as an accepted label or a released image, so later readers cannot tell what the status was allowed to mean. We call a decision record sufficient if it is true and a reader who has only the record and the items it cites can explain the status, bound it, re-derive it and challenge it. From these four uses we argue for ten questions a record must answer, map them onto the author's earlier JSON Schema for decision records (DRK v0.1), and define four mechanical checks. We separate conformance, which the checks decide; adequacy, whether the answers are specific enough to use, which needs a reader; fidelity, which no check on the record decides; and merits, which sufficiency does not require. On 164 single-defect variants of three synthetic records, schema validation, the only check DRK v0.1 implements, rejects every variant with a deleted required property and none of the others, and it accepts a record whose claim, rule, scope, limits and challenge route are empty. These are properties of the schema shown on defects we seeded, not estimates of performance on real records. A false record passes every check. The statement-of-reasons schema of the EU Digital Services Act Transparency Database answers 4 of the questions in full, 2 in part and 4 not at all: why the matter was unsettled, what the status depends on, whether it can be re-derived, and how to challenge it. In 25 real statements from 25 platforms, drawn by a seeded rule and coded by a language model and checked by the author, free text addressed any of those four in only 2, and in 18 (24 under a stricter reading adopted during coding) no free text said why the item fell under the rule. No deployment or legal claim is made.

title: Adaptive Line Switching for Cascade Mitigation in Power Systems via Graph Reinforcement Learning
summary: Although cascading failures are relatively rare events in power systems, they pose significant risks and can lead to severe economic and societal consequences within a short period. Therefore, developing effective mitigation strategies to prevent cascade propagation and to minimize their impacts is essential. This paper presents a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based framework for adaptive transmission line switching to mitigate cascading failures. Given the important role of network topology and component interactions in cascading failure propagation in power systems, graph-based DRL approaches, including Graph-DQN, Graph-A2C, and Graph-PPO frameworks, are developed to capture and utilize the topological information of power systems. The proposed frameworks are evaluated on the IEEE 39, 57, and 118 bus systems and benchmarked against the unmitigated case, random and heuristic-based switching strategies as baselines, as well as their corresponding graph-agnostic DRL counterparts. The results demonstrate the importance of incorporating graph information into these mitigation frameworks, leading to reduced cascade size, load loss, and network clustering.

title: A Study of Fixed versus Adaptive Step Sizes for Phasor Dynamics Simulations
summary: Transient phasor dynamics simulations model the response of power systems to disturbances using differential-algebraic equations (DAEs). Fixed-step integration is widely used to solve these DAEs numerically, but a step size suitable for resolving a fault transient may be unnecessarily small during the rest of a simulation. In this work, we provide a quantitative comparison of fixed and adaptive backward differentiation formulas on a suite of seven grid test cases ranging from 200 to 70,000 buses. Adaptive step sizes automatically shrink near faults, perturbations, and controller limits, and grow during less active portions of the simulation. At the global error achieved by a fixed quarter-cycle step size, adaptive results give 1.8 to 2.6 times speedups. Local error distributions, step size profiles, and work-precision plots show how accuracy, nonlinear solver, and step selection contribute to these differences. The results establish adaptive integration as the preferred approach for these simulations.

title: Stability Does Not Mirror Plasticity: A Module-Level View of Declarative and Procedural Learning in Transformers
summary: Plasticity and stability in continual learning are typically studied at the entire-model level and in a task-agnostic manner, yet prior work has reported divergent conclusions across settings. Inspired by cognitive distinctions between declarative and procedural memory, we instead study how plasticity and stability vary across transformer modules and task types. In a controlled synthetic environment with clean measurement, we show a double dissociation: query-key (QK) and value-output (VO) projections are the most plastic on procedural tasks, whereas MLPs are the most plastic on declarative memorization. Stability, however, does not simply mirror plasticity: when learning a new procedure, updating QK retains over half of the stored declarative memory, while updating MLPs retains far less and updating VO loses roughly four-fifths. Targeted module reset-and-recovery experiments explain this asymmetry: plasticity tracks which module is best suited to a task's primary computation or storage, whereas stability depends on all ways the existing capability relies on that module, including access to information stored in other modules. Experiments on a realistic model and tasks broadly echo these asymmetric dynamics. Overall, our work shows that plasticity and stability depend on different aspects of a module's functional role, offering a task-dependent, module-level perspective on continual learning.

title: When Does Subspace Direction Matter for LoRA? Regime Analysis of the Magnitude Principle in Few-Shot Adaptation
comments: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 43 pages, 5 figures. Code: https://github.com/Nischal1011/pivotlora
summary: We show that the importance of a LoRA adapter's initial input-subspace direction is regime-dependent, and we characterize this dependence in theory and experiment. This refines the recent view that spectral initializers help through update magnitude alone. Direction matters most when labeled data are scarce relative to the representation dimension and the activation subspace used for initialization captures supervised task structure. In this regime, the adapter's row span remains sensitive to its starting point, making task-aligned initialization especially useful. A spiked-covariance perturbation analysis characterizes the finite-sample stability of the estimated subspace. A first-step analysis of LoRA training explains why the subspace's alignment with the task matters and motivates an alignment coefficient $ρ$ that closely tracks gains across classification tasks. We test this account with PivotLoRA, which initializes adapters from activation PCA at prediction-relevant positions and applies one output-preserving orthogonal pivot early in training. In few-shot BERT-base classification, PivotLoRA achieves the best average rank among 13 methods and improves over vanilla LoRA in 29 of 30 settings, even though it starts from a smaller input-factor initialization norm. Additional classification experiments extend the evaluation to 7B and 8B Llama decoders. Classification gains diminish with more labeled data, consistent with the proposed regime dependence. A targeted extension to completion-only reasoning also shows improvements on GSM8K and StrategyQA. These findings identify conditions under which initialization direction matters, with subspace-task alignment offering a low-cost diagnostic before training for classification.

title: Bits, Not Boxes: Label-Free Layer Selection for Visual Localization in VLMs
summary: Attention maps cheaply show where a vision-language model (VLM) looks, but attention sinks make them unreliable for localization. Contrasting the question with a generic prompt suppresses sinks, yet only some layers localize the queried object. Existing methods find these layers with box annotations or fixed rules. We show that attention itself can identify them. A question changes how much a head attends to the image and where this attention goes. The two effects separate exactly, and the second, measured in bits on unlabeled questions, indicates which layers localize. WhereBits turns these where-to-look bits into a layer prior and combines it with per-head contrastive scores. Its three design constants were fixed once on labeled COCO data, and a new model or resolution needs only unlabeled questions. Across eight VLMs, WhereBits matches the pointing accuracy of box-tuned layers on COCO and RefCOCO and ranks target tokens better. This advantage holds on a held-out model family and at higher resolutions. Its COCO pointing accuracy is 0.72, against 0.22 for mean attention. In training-free zoom-in, its crops raise V* accuracy by 6.0 points under forced-choice evaluation.

title: Conformally Calibrated Adaptive Computation in Neural Operators
summary: Selecting less computation in a neural operator need not reduce inference time. We study this gap using conformal calibration to choose Fourier modes or channel width per input subject to a fixed error budget. A triangle-inequality envelope bounds all candidates simultaneously; a direct-score rule handles non-monotone candidate errors and, with an input-independent score, calibrates a static baseline under the same marginal guarantee. Under frozen-model and exchangeability assumptions, both rules bound the probability of issuing a prediction outside the budget and abstain when calibration is infeasible. On Burgers and Darcy flow across three training seeds, mode selection reduces active spectral support without a measurable latency reduction, because full-grid transforms and channel mixing dominate the cost. Narrowing channels does reduce Darcy forward cost, but reference-based selection must first compute the dense prediction. An input-only binary width selector avoids that pass and runs at 0.52-0.95 times dense latency; yet static widths calibrated under the same rule are often as fast or faster, and on a separately generated 1,000-example test set they generally achieve higher coverage, while the selector falls below its 90% target in more than half of the settings. Adaptive computation in neural operators should therefore be judged by achieved coverage and complete runtime against a matched static comparator.

title: TransFIRA+: Transfer Learning for Biometric Recognizability Assessment
summary: Biometric recognition in surveillance, video, and web imagery must contend with extreme variation in pose, blur, illumination, occlusion, and distance, where visual quality metrics fail to predict whether inputs are recognizable to the deployed encoder. Existing face image quality assessment methods rely on visual heuristics, curated annotations, or costly generative pipelines, leaving their predictions detached from the encoder's decision geometry. We introduce TransFIRA, a lightweight framework that grounds recognizability directly in embedding space. TransFIRA derives class-center similarity (CCS) and class-center angular separation (CCAS) from a pretrained encoder's embeddings and learns to predict them from images without quality annotations. Using predicted CCS for template weighting and CCAS>0 as a natural filtering threshold yields state-of-the-art face verification performance on BRIAR, raising TAR at $10^{-6}$ FMR from 0.085 with uniform averaging to 0.598. The predicted scores also reveal how image degradations affect encoder-specific recognizability. TransFIRA+ extends this framework to cross-camera multimodal person identification in untrimmed surveillance video. In this setting, body recognizability scores saturate within a narrow range, making direct weighting effectively uniform. We introduce a post-hoc sigmoid calibration that transforms these saturated scores into informative weights without retraining. After calibration, the BRIAR-trained TransFIRA predictor improves fused face and body identification on two unseen multi-camera datasets, outperforming detector-confidence weighting and uncalibrated CCS-rank weighting. Together, TransFIRA and TransFIRA+ demonstrate that encoder-grounded recognizability generalizes across biometric modalities and recognition settings.

title: RummiAlgebra: A Polynomial Representation Framework for Game-Based Algebra Learning with Jokers
summary: Connecting symbolic expressions to manipulable objects is a recurring challenge in introductory algebra. This paper presents RummiAlgebra, a design-oriented framework and browser-based prototype that maps a Rummikub-style tile-rearrangement task to polynomial addition, common-factor extraction, finite geometric sums, and context-dependent substitution. A numbered colored tile is encoded as a monomial c x^v, while a physical joker is represented by a distinct symbol J_i whose algebraic role is fixed only for a particular candidate arrangement. We define admissible polynomial forms for runs and groups and establish an inventory-conservation invariant. A soundness-and-completeness proof shows that physical-tile accounting together with the algebraic run/group templates characterizes valid final arrangements under the stated classroom rules; polynomial equality alone is insufficient. Four detailed examples illustrate decomposition, competing factorizations, one- and two-joker substitutions, and optimization as an optional extension. A targeted review distinguishes the approach from established Rummikub solvers, Rummikub-inspired arithmetic-sequence activities, algebra-tile manipulatives, and polynomial games. The prototype implements six small challenges and a separate rule-and-expression checker; their optimal scores were checked against an independent exhaustive reference enumerator. These checks establish agreement for the examples but do not establish learning effectiveness or novelty of the underlying algebraic operations. We close with a classroom sequence, assessment constructs, and a controlled evaluation protocol. The claimed contribution is a formally specified pedagogical correspondence and an interactive proof-oriented activity, not a new asymptotically faster Rummikub solver.

title: Why Sub-4-Bit Vision CNNs Collapse and Where Mixed-Precision Recovery Stops
summary: Deep vision models operating in resource-constrained environments depend heavily on low-bit quantization, yet compressing weights below 4 bits frequently induces catastrophic accuracy collapse. While mixed-precision recovery strategies aim to rescue accuracy by selectively retaining high-precision parameters, the fundamental mechanics of where and why these models collapse remain poorly understood. In this study, we systematically analyze the anatomy of quantization collapse across standard Vision CNNs (including ResNet and EfficientNet backbones) evaluated on the full 50,000-image ImageNet-1k validation set. First, we map the exact progression of degradation, demonstrating that collapse is highly non-linear and concentrated in late-stage pointwise projections and depthwise layers. Second, we introduce a structured, multi-step recovery waterfall that evaluates selective integer precision (INT4/INT8) and selective floating-point scales. We show that keeping less than 5% of critical layer activations in 8-bit precision recovers up to 92% of the accuracy lost during aggressive sub-4-bit compression. Finally, we bridge the hardware reality gap by evaluating deployment performance on standard ARM and x86 CPU architectures. We show that while low-bit quantization reduces memory storage requirements, standard runtime software bit-unpacking introduces a 1.48x to 21.5x execution slowdown depending on batch size, highlighting a critical trade-off between model footprint and actual edge throughput. Our findings provide a practical blueprint for navigating the limits of sub-4-bit deployment without sacrificing hardware performance.

title: Where Global Context and Weight Sharing Work in Compact Vision Backbones
summary: Compact convolutional backbones such as EfficientNet achieve strong parameter efficiency through local depthwise separable convolutions, yet two structural questions remain central to hybrid design: where does global self-attention improve recognition over pure convolution, and can repeated blocks share weights without losing representational capacity? We investigate both questions on ImageNet-1k (50,000-image validation) using controlled EfficientNet-B0 experiments. First, we show that wrapping a classification backbone in multi-scale feature pyramids (BiFPN) fails to outperform a plain MBConv trunk (69.99% - 71.81% vs. 72.86% plain B0) until paired with stage attention (73.15%). In contrast, keeping the MBConv trunk intact and inserting lightweight zero-gated residual self-attention adapters at stages P3 (28x28 windowed), P4 (14x14 global), and P5 (7x7 global) reaches 74.02% standalone and outperforms a bit-for-bit matched plain-B0 control by +0.954 percentage points (73.88% vs. 72.92%) across an 88-epoch stateless replay schedule, with learned attention amplitude rising monotonically with semantic depth (27.2% at P3 -> 45.4% at P4 -> 66.3% at P5). Second, we evaluate recurrent weight sharing across repeated MBConv blocks with pass-specific BatchNorm statistics (+1,536 parameters per pass). While post-hoc kernel averaging degrades accuracy to 17.03% and single-template stage tying (-27.6% parameters) plateaus at 66.10%, alternating two shared block templates ([B1, A, B, A]) in Stage 6 cuts total model parameters by 10.9% (582K weights) and recovers by +10.82 points in a single epoch to 70.92% (-1.84 points vs. unshared control).

title: NIRJALA: Draining the Sea out of Gaussian Splatting with Three-Path Optics and Reversible Physics
summary: Water does not just tint an underwater photograph; it rewrites it. Each pixel mixes attenuated scene radiance, backscattered light, and scene light scattered forward on its way to the camera, and many combinations of scene and water explain the same pixels. Most Gaussian-splatting methods for underwater scenes model only the first two effects and remove the water by dividing by a transmission that decays exponentially with range, so their inversion gain grows without bound. We present NIRJALA (Sanskrit for "without water"), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that recovers water-free appearance and geometry together. TRIVENI, a three-path image formation model, adds a range-saturating forward-scattering term to direct transmission and backscatter; we prove that this keeps the inversion gain bounded at every range and bound how errors in the estimated backscatter and attenuation propagate into the recovered colours. PRATIBIMBA, a reversible physics anchor, ties a flexible neural water model to a ten-parameter physical model in both directions, so scene content cannot hide inside the water. SAMARASA collects the physics-informed objectives, including a range-binned colour prior. To score water removal against ground truth, we built SAJALA ("with water"), a 30-scene suite path-traced in Blender Cycles with water-free images, depth, and normals under controlled water colour and turbidity. On SAJALA, NIRJALA raises PSNR from 24.34 to 24.76 dB and lowers depth AbsRel from 0.109 to 0.091 against the strongest baseline; on real SeaThru-NeRF scenes it lowers LPIPS from 0.194 to 0.175 while rendering at 44 FPS. We also discuss where appearance metrics and geometry disagree underwater, and the limits of our evaluation.

title: LusoClin: A Synthetic Clinical Note Dataset for Medical Information Retrieval in European Portuguese
summary: Access to large-scale clinical text collections is crucial for advancing medical information retrieval research, including clinical note search, patient cohort identification, and domain-adapted retrieval models. However, real clinical notes are rarely available due to privacy regulations, which particularly limits progress for low-resource languages such as European Portuguese. We present LusoClin, a publicly released dataset of synthetic clinical notes in European Portuguese, created to support privacy-preserving research on clinical text retrieval. LusoClin was generated by pre-processing real clinical data, fine-tuning the open-source Llama 3.2 (3B) instruction-tuned model using Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation, and applying prompt-based clinical note generation. To facilitate semantic indexing and clinical search, the notes are automatically annotated with clinical entities using a BERT-based model. We evaluate LusoClin in terms of utility, fidelity, diversity, and privacy using automatic metrics and human evaluation. Results indicate that the dataset captures clinically relevant language patterns and can support downstream IR applications such as clinical document retrieval and domain-specific model adaptation, although annotators can often distinguish synthetic from real notes and some medical inconsistencies persist.

title: VeriMath: Human-in-the-Loop Generation and Verification of Curriculum-Aligned Mathematics Assessment Items
summary: Automatic generation of mathematics assessment items is a growing area in educational artificial intelligence, yet classroom deployment remains challenging. Generated questions must satisfy multiple constraints: mathematical correctness, curriculum alignment, appropriate cognitive difficulty, and educator reviewability. While prior work has advanced text generation, reliable assessment authoring requires granular control over localized examination formats and expert educational judgment. To address this challenge, we present VeriMath, a generalized, human-in-the-loop framework for generating rigorous, curriculum-constrained mathematics assessment drafts. Using annotated reference items, the framework anchors generation to the requested examination section and cognitive reasoning level, then applies sequential automated verification and guided repair before submitting drafts for expert review. We evaluate VeriMath through a national curriculum case study using 4,555 mathematics items from the Vietnamese Grade 12 curriculum and 50 distinct generation requirements covering multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer formats. Across two model backbones, the framework produces verifier-accepted drafts for 94% (47/50) of requirements per run. Blind expert evaluations confirm high mathematical accuracy and curriculum alignment, with strict teacher-readiness assessments accepting up to 56.8% of generated items. Analysis of rejected drafts reveals persistent domain-agnostic challenges involving formatting, statement validity, and solution-step completeness. These findings demonstrate that VeriMath can bridge generative AI and dependable educational applications by producing highly reviewable assessment drafts within tightly constrained national curriculum frameworks.

title: FACT: Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model generation by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model pass. However, better draft predictions and longer accepted continuations do not necessarily produce faster generation. To examine this gap, we present FACT (Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training), an experimental framework for studying how drafter training, candidate allocation, and execution conditions jointly affect acceptance and latency. Using a lightweight feature-prediction drafter with a frozen Llama-3-8B-Instruct target under greedy decoding, we first examine how training translates into accepted tokens. Backpropagating through predicted-feature rollouts with greater weight on early steps improves acceptance by 15-24% over uniformly weighted detached training, yet average rollout proxy cross-entropy does not reliably rank drafters by acceptance. Beyond prediction quality, the placement of draft candidates also matters: with a fixed 256-node budget and matched per-depth widths, replacing static allocation with confidence-guided allocation increases speedup over autoregressive decoding from $1.46\times$ to $2.02\times$ on HumanEval and from $1.31\times$ to $1.75\times$ on MT-Bench. This allocation benefit extends to an independently trained drafter, but stronger training does not consistently amplify it, showing that the two improvements do not necessarily reinforce each other. Even these speed gains depend on execution conditions: changing only host-thread settings can nearly eliminate speedup without changing acceptance. Together, these findings show why training and allocation must be evaluated jointly using both acceptance and end-to-end latency under controlled execution conditions.

title: Interference-Aware Tone Selection for Bluetooth Channel Sounding
summary: Bluetooth Channel Sounding enables distance estimation using phase measurements across multiple frequencies. However, coexistence with Wi-Fi and other 2.4 GHz radios can fragment the available frequency band, making reliable ranging difficult when only a limited number of tones can be selected. Drawing on sparse antenna-array theory, we show that interference avoidance alone is insufficient: the spacing of selected tones can introduce repeated peaks in the ranging response, leading to estimation errors. We propose a lightweight, interference-aware tone-selection method that jointly considers frequency occupancy, tone spacing, and frequency span. Our method constructs a 15-tone map using a three-step rule without ranging measurements, ground-truth distance, or online candidate-map search. We evaluate the method using simulations of 900 indoor environments, a public Bluetooth Channel Sounding dataset, and measurements from commercial Nordic nRF54L15 hardware. Compared with random interference avoiding baseline, our proposed method improves ranging success percentage by 39 points under mixed interference, 29 points on the public dataset, and 82 points in hardware experiments. These results demonstrate the importance of tone selection for practical Bluetooth Channel Sounding.

title: Reliability by Architecture: Agentic Workflows for Validated Multi-Physics Simulation from Natural Language
summary: Preparing, executing, and validating strongly coupled multi-physics simulations require expert time. Agentic workflows use large language models (LLMs) to coordinate them from natural-language descriptions, but reliability requires checks of physical consistency and fidelity to the problem description. Our agentic harness implements explicit task allocation: LLMs interpret user requests and simulator diagnostics, generate input components not covered by predefined construction rules, and propose repairs, while deterministic routines construct supported components and check inputs, edits, and results. We evaluate CO2-storage problems using the multi-physics simulator GEOS, from compositional flow to flow-poromechanics with frictional fault contact. In 80 attempts on two flow problems, grounding raises the proportion of structurally valid inputs from 5/20 to 20/20, but acceptance reaches 20/20 only with complete rule-based input preparation. With identical inputs, local repairs correct three seeded defects while preserving valid inputs. Supporting tests identify simulations passing physics checks despite differing from the problem description or reference results.

summary: Official development assistance fell by 23.1 per cent in 2025, and the decision of who is helped first when there is not enough for everyone is moving into software. A leading published machine-learning targeting system excluded 53 per cent of eligible households as deployed. If the rule of distribution ends up in code, it should carry the judgement of many cultures, and the machine should execute while a person judges. AllotNet is an interpretable mixture-of-experts conditional logit for the allocation judgements elicited by Allot, a pre-registered six-language instrument: eight linear taste experts over seven ethical criteria, weighted by a gate over participant context, with a damped residual, an encoder for household intake, an outcome head and a budget-constrained planner that builds a review queue and never rejects anyone. A model of human judgement has no answer key on real data, so we wrote one first: a planted synthetic population of 5.6 million sessions and 104 million responses (98 million usable choices), generated by the production code path from a ground truth hidden from the loss. All sixteen pre-specified checks passed: criterion ranking $ρ= 1.000$, hidden segments recovered (ARI 0.671), outcome head at 99 per cent of the noise ceiling, planner at 99.4 per cent of oracle. The caveats are reported with them: two checks are weaker than their titles, and a live-generation failure cost 260,712 seeds. The model has 23,550 parameters, is trained quantisation-aware for NVFP4 with its interpretable core in fp32 (welfare-rank parity $ρ= 0.9937$ at W4A16 on the shipped bundle; one parity threshold was relaxed post hoc), and ships as a 125 KB bundle with C11, Java, Rust and Python runtimes. Nothing has been trained on real data yet; at the study's real scale a hierarchical Bayesian mixed logit is the registered comparator.

title: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
comments: Equal contribution: Minghe Zhang and Xuetao Kang. 38 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables
summary: Autonomous AI agents pair a frozen base model with an editable harness of prompts, skills, tool rules, and memory. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) adapts this harness from experience without weight updates, yet self-editing without external graders often backfires: reflection and scalar scores conflate what an edit newly broke with what remains unsolved, causing local regressions, skill forgetting, and memory bloat. We introduce GUARD (Grader-free Unsupervised Environment Design [UED] with Adaptive Rule Distillation), a closed-loop framework for reference-free continual harness evolution. Our key insight is to decompose each task into pre-execution self-checks and guide harness updates via directional regret. Each round grades trajectories against these checks, pinning mastered rules while prioritizing newly broken behaviors, and selects among parallel candidate edits by critic-free group-relative fitness. A Soft-HURT gate then promotes an edit only when gains outweigh regressions, scoping specialized fixes to prevent over-triggering and guaranteeing non-regression on its gated buffer. At test time, one frozen harness runs in a single pass. Across benchmarks on memory, skill evolution, continual task streams, and domain reasoning, GUARD consistently improves performance without catastrophic forgetting or memory pollution while substantially cutting deployment token usage.

title: mmTherm: Absolute 3D Human Pose Estimation from Low-Resolution Thermal Images and mmWave Radar
summary: Absolute 3D human pose estimation (HPE) aims to recover both a person's body pose and their global position in 3D space. Privacy-preserving millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides distance and direction measurement capabilities, but its sparse point clouds make HPE under-constrained. Low-resolution thermal imaging can provide complementary observations of body direction and structure. However, our evaluation shows that a strong feature-level fusion baseline loses much of its localization and HPE advantage when generalizing to unseen subjects, with radial localization becoming less accurate than a radar-only baseline. Motivated by this finding, we introduce mmTherm, a lightweight framework that explicitly incorporates the complementary geometric properties of thermal imaging and mmWave radar. It combines body structure and joint directions estimated from thermal images with range information from radar to localize the body and reconstruct its 3D pose. Experiments on OctoNet show that mmTherm reduces cross-user absolute joint error by 33% and root localization error by 38% relative to the strongest corresponding baselines, while requiring substantially fewer parameters and less computation at inference.
